questions.prompt: An Azure VM has host CPU metrics but enhanced guest monitoring is not enabled. You need guest memory performance data in the classic logs-based monitoring experience. Required permissions and destination access are available. Which collection configuration meets the goal?

options.text: Enable logs-based enhanced monitoring with AMA, the required performance DCR association, and a Log Analytics workspace.
options.explanation: Guest counters require collection inside the VM; the classic experience uses its performance collection configuration and Log Analytics destination.

options.text: Associate an AMA DCR selecting only Windows event logs and the Log Analytics destination.
options.explanation: Guest event-log collection alone does not select the required guest memory performance counters.

options.text: Associate an AMA DCR selecting only Linux Syslog and the Log Analytics destination.
options.explanation: Syslog messages are a different data source from the required memory performance measurements.

options.text: Export only VM platform metrics through a diagnostic setting to the Log Analytics workspace.
options.explanation: Exporting host metrics does not enable collection of the missing guest memory data.

questions.prompt: A new VM deployment needs supported guest performance monitoring, without a requirement for the legacy dependency Map. An old guide includes Dependency Agent and VM Insights Map in every deployment. Which plan follows Microsoft’s current guidance?

options.text: Install Dependency Agent alone and use it for guest performance collection.
options.explanation: Dependency Agent is not the supported AMA guest performance collection path; the deprecated Map feature should not be enabled for new deployments.

options.text: Configure AMA and supported guest performance collection, and omit the deprecated Map/Dependency Agent feature.
options.explanation: Microsoft supports AMA guest monitoring and explicitly advises against enabling Map/Dependency Agent for new deployments.

options.text: Configure AMA guest performance collection and also enable Map/Dependency Agent for every new VM.
options.explanation: The additional legacy feature conflicts with the explicit guidance not to enable it for new deployments.

options.text: Use only the legacy Log Analytics agent for the new guest monitoring deployment.
options.explanation: The legacy agent is no longer supported; current guidance uses Azure Monitor Agent.

questions.prompt: You configure the supported OpenTelemetry guest-metrics experience for an Azure VM, rather than classic logs-based metrics. Which resource type stores those collected metrics?

options.explanation: This is the destination for classic logs-based VM monitoring and guest logs, not this OpenTelemetry metrics experience.
An event-streaming namespace is not the destination specified by the VM OpenTelemetry metrics workflow.
The OpenTelemetry VM metrics experience uses this workspace type.
Archive storage is not the metrics destination for the specified enhanced monitoring workflow.
